integrity: Self-contained proof over algebraically closed characteristic five; exact standalone checks corroborate, not replace, the all-r argument. Independent validation absent.
scientific_limitations: Determines only geometric 5-rank for the prime-power tower; does not determine Newton polygons, Ekedahl–Oort types, general-family p-rank or zeta functions. General cyclic-cover formulas and incompletely accessible earlier sources remain residual novelty risks.
title: Constant geometric 5-rank three in an unbounded-genus hyperelliptic tower
